doc: Exit criterion 1, the manager half, on mocks. A manager agent (a mock whose prompts are its program, so it acts only through its MCP tools) runs the three-provider plan of system/three-providers-one-plan-under-balanced under Balanced: it starts one worker per task with agent_start on a subscription Claude, a Gemini and an API-key profile; its Codex start is refused (CODEX_LOCK_PROVEN). The user's cells: code.edit asks for the mock-gemini profile, and network is never for the manager's own profile. Each worker is the manager's child on its own task; the Claude and API-key workers' edits are answered at once by the matrix with no card; the Gemini worker's edit reaches the event stream and waits behind exactly one matrix card until the user answers. Then the manager asks the Claude worker (agent_message) to fetch a URL: the worker's network ask is refused by the hub (reject_once, no card), because the worker's column is clamped to the manager's, while a worker the user starts on that profile may fetch (matrix/check). It fails if the manager cannot start a worker through its tools, if a worker is not the manager's child or not on its task, if an in-matrix action makes a card or waits, if the Gemini ask runs without a card or the user's answer, if the worker's fetch is allowed or asks, or if Codex starts.
